label: rejected
reviewer: blind fresh agent (renders + close-ups + gate report + rubric only)

evidence.V1: Front and three-quarter read instantly as a heater shield, and the outline is symmetric (rivet pairs mirror about x~256, A15 X error 3e-05). But the plate is a flat slab, so the top view at 64 px is just a gold plank with a stub, which is readable from front angles only
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big gold rim plate, medium raised teal field and cream chevron, small steel rivets (10) and an ink handle on the back
evidence.V3: No correctness failure (A15/A16 pass, seats penetrate 0.016-0.08 with no gaps). Proportions are stiff though: a perfectly flat plate with no belly or curvature, a straight top edge, a uniform rim and a thin, small chevron
evidence.V4: Rim, field and chevron all carry a visible chamfer that catches the studio light, consistently across the main forms
evidence.V5: Rivets are low-segment polyhedra: the flat close-up shows 6-8-sided outlines and the studio close-up shows lumpy, broken highlights. The outer rim curve at the lower right shows straight facet segments. That is stray faceting, so V5 is capped at 1
evidence.V6: Disciplined palette: gold accent rim, one teal field hue, warm cream emblem, steel-grey rivets, ink handle, with good value contrast
evidence.V7: 1972 tris against a weapon target of 2500 (ceiling 4000), which is under target
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material and the palette roles match the kit. But the hue appears in only one value (no 3-value use on the field or bevels), and the faceted rivets break the kit's smooth-shaded look
evidence.V9: Studio line is complete: origin at the handle, CollisionFidelity Box, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic

artifacts: Rivets visibly faceted (6-8-sided outline in flat light, lumpy speculars in studio light) on all 10 rivets
Outer rim silhouette shows straight facet segments along the curved lower sides (close_rim_studio / close_rim_flat)
top_fixes: Raise rivet segment count / use smooth domed caps so the rivets read as round studs (clears V5 and V8)
Add a slight convex curvature (belly) to the plate so the top and side views read as a shield rather than a flat plank (V1, V3)
Add more segments to the rim's curved sides to remove the visible facet steps along the outline
Use the field hue in 3 values (e.g. a darker field bevel or inner band, a lighter highlight) to match the kit palette rule
Push the stylisation: enlarge the chevron emblem and give the top edge a subtle arc or flare for a more confident silhouette
